text:
mike (eng-platform): thinking aloud — we should support role-aware routing so routes can bind to role-scoped quota buckets. would help enterprises who want different SLAs per role.

kavya (product): high-level yes. curious how this shows in console — do we add a ‘role bindings’ panel on the route detail? :thinking:?

mike (eng-platform): exactly. UI would let you attach one or more role selectors (tenant.role == "billing") to the route and pick quota bucket + fallback. small sketch: role selector + bucket dropdown + priority weight.

emily (eng-platform): implementation note — runtime needs fast eval of role selectors per request. we can reuse existing scope matcher but need to tag telemetry for effective_permission to debug mismatches.

dan (eng-runtime): on the runtime side we can evaluate principal roles from the token and route in O(1) if we precompile selectors to bitmaps. downside: adds memory per route. perf numbers: +3% mem, sub-ms decision.

jenn (security): a couple questions — who can create role->route bindings? should be tenant admins only. we must ensure audit log entries include the binding change and which role was used at request time.

mike (eng-platform): agree. default UX: only admins can edit bindings. non-admins can view. add an audit card in console and event in audit log service.

kavya (product): UX concern: large orgs have hundreds of roles. dropdowns don't scale. we should add search + saved presets + preview of affected callers.

emily (eng-platform): preview could be a synthetic sample: show N sample tokens matched by selected role selector. quick way to validate before you commit.

dan (eng-runtime): API proposal (very small) — add to Route proto:

```proto
message RoleBinding {
  string selector = 1; // e.g. "tenant:acme/role:billing" or expr
  string quota_bucket = 2;
  int32 weight = 3; // fallback ordering
}
message Route {
  repeated RoleBinding role_bindings = X;
}
```

mike (eng-platform): + telemetry: we should emit labels: `route_id`, `applied_role`, `quota_bucket`, `binding_id` so console dashboards can surface cost/latency by role. example event JSON: 

```json
{
  "route_id":"r-123",
  "applied_role":"billing",
  "quota_bucket":"enterprise-high",
  "tokens":42,
  "latency_ms":12
}
```

jenn (security): ensure `applied_role` is derived from token claims server-side. do not let client-supplied metadata override it. also redact any PII in telemetry.

emily (eng-platform): noted. also need retention policy — role-level telemetry is high-cardinality, maybe 90d by default for enterprises and 30d for self-serve.

kavya (product): decision points for next week: 1) expose role binding editor in route detail or separate tab, 2) API proto change and rollout plan, 3) telemetry retention default, 4) admin-only edit enforcement.

mike (eng-platform): propose we do canary: enable feature-flagged UI + API in staging -> limited prod tenants -> broader rollout. ops-bot, can you open a rollout ticket? :robot_face:

ops-bot: created ticket RT-4521 — "role-aware-route-quota-rollout" with canary steps and rollback playbook.

dan (eng-runtime): I'll prototype the bitmap matcher and perf test. emily, let's sync on telemetry schema.

emily (eng-platform): syncing tomorrow 11am. I'll bring the UX mock and sample queries for dashboards.

jenn (security): I'll draft the audit and data-retention policy doc. will loop in legal if needed.

kavya (product): awesome. milestone: have proto + UI mock + rollout ticket by EOD Friday. ack? :thumbsup:

mike (eng-platform): ack. thanks everyone.
